lines.text: How's the neck been since last time?
Since last time the headaches have dropped to about two a week, though I haven't kept proper count.
That's real progress. Let me have a look at your turning.
You've got about seventy degrees turning to the left now, and the right is still stiff at about fifty.
Same again with the chin tucks, and set an alarm to get up from the desk every forty minutes.
Right, all done for today. See you next week.
Oh, sorry, one more thing. Since last time I've had some tingling in my right thumb when I'm on the laptop.
Okay, good that you said. Sit back down a minute and I'll check the nerve in your arm.
Your grip and reflexes are normal, so it's most likely posture related, but tell me straight away if the thumb goes numb or weak.
